name: HMS Hermes

sources.title: HMS Hermes (95) — the first purpose-built aircraft carrier, 1924, 182.9 m; sunk by Japanese aircraft on 9 April 1942 off Batticaloa
Sri Lanka national shipwreck register — HMS Hermes: 40-53 m, technical diving
PADI Pros blog — HMS Hermes: on her port side at about 52 m, the control tower nearly intact

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q596282_hms_hermes.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her port side at about 52 m, largely intact: the enclosed bow, the hangar, the flight deck torn and holed by the bombs, the island with its tripod and funnel, the 5.5-inch guns in their sponsons, twin screws; plates from the flight deck on the bottom. A war grave (307 men). The list, the heading (not published: 0), the bomb damage in detail and the colours are approximate. model_built.glb: the carrier as she sailed in 1942. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
